title: Design System: Bay State Pet & Garden Supply

display.purpose: Hero headlines and section anchors. Arvo slab-serif at heavy weight, uppercase, tight tracking. One per screen.

body.purpose: Product descriptions, footer text, admin body copy. Inter at 400 weight, 0.875–1rem, 65ch max line length.

label.purpose: Badges, buttons, category tags, status indicators, form labels. Inter at 900 weight, 0.625–0.75rem, uppercase, 0.15em+ letter-spacing.

price.purpose: Product prices only. Arvo at 900 weight, 1.25rem, tight tracking. The only number in display type.

shadows.name: stamp-sm
shadows.purpose: Badges and small chips. Lightest stamp lift.

shadows.name: stamp-md
shadows.purpose: Product cards on hover, dialogs, sheet panels. Primary interactive elevation.

shadows.name: stamp-lg
shadows.purpose: Department cards on homepage. Heavy architectural cards that anchor the layout.

shadows.name: stamp-hero
shadows.purpose: Hero text boxes over images. Larger offset with transparency so it doesn't overpower the image.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover transitions and state changes.

motion.name: duration-default
motion.purpose: Standard state transitions. Button hovers, badge changes.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Sheet openings, dialog entries, mega menu drops.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call-to-action button. Uniform Green background, cream text, square corners, heavy label typography.

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Input
components.description: Square text input with warm border, cream background. Focus ring in Uniform Green.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; background: #FFF8D8; color: #211414; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; border: 1px solid #E7D8A8; border-radius: 0; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #E7D8A8; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #6B3A18; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #14532D; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(20,83,45,0.5); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #EF4444; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"]:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(239,68,68,0.3); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; background: #E7D8A8; cursor: not-allowed; }

narrative.overview:
This is a digital general store — warm, practical, and built from paper and wood, not glass and gradients. Every surface should feel like something you could touch: stamped badges, heavy card-stock cards, thick inked borders. The website is an extension of the physical store at 429 Winthrop Street, not a separate brand experiment.

The system is high-contrast and high-weight: bold slab-serif display type, near-black text on cream stock, and hard-offset shadows that feel physical rather than atmospheric. It's confident, not loud. Decisions that grab attention do so for reasons a store manager would recognize.

What this system rejects: Shopify template farms with their hero sliders and "curated collections." Chewy.com big-box polish and algorithmic cross-sells. Generic SaaS cream with ghost buttons and soft corners. Logo-first palettes that treat the website like a brand deck.
keyCharacteristics: Stamped not floating — hard shadows, thick borders, square corners
Physical not digital — the palette evokes aprons, signage, paper bags, inked stamps
Weighted not whispered — font-black headings, uppercase labels, 4px–8px border separators
Semantic not decorative — accent colors signal meaning (sale, pre-order, pickup), not mood
Store-first — every design choice answers "would this make sense on a shelf tag?"

rules.name: The 60/25/10/5 Rule
rules.body: Cream and white hold 60% of the surface. Uniform Green carries 25%. Signet Burgundy takes 10%. Corner Callout Gold is limited to 5%. If gold appears on more than 5% of a screen, something is wrong.

rules.name: The Never Black Rule
rules.body: No #000, no #fff. Every neutral is tinted warm — Ledger Charcoal (#211414) for dark, Feed Bag Cream (#FFF8D8) for light.

rules.name: The Accent Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Corner Callout Gold and Signet Burgundy are never decorative. They appear only when there's a semantic reason — a sale, a feature, a status, a warning.

rules.name: The One Display Per Screen Rule
rules.body: Arvo display text (font-black uppercase tracking-tighter) appears on at most one element per visible screen area. Two competing display elements dilute each other.

rules.name: The Label Is Never Quiet Rule
rules.body: All label text is font-black, uppercase, and tracked out by at least 0.15em. A label at font-medium or normal-case is a bug, not a choice.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to interaction (hover, focus, open). A card with a permanent shadow is visually dishonest.

rules.name: The No Blur Rule
rules.body: Shadows in this system have zero blur-radius. 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15) is the language of SaaS dashboards, not general stores.

rules.name: The Admin Is Dark & Border-Only Rule
rules.body: The admin portal is dark-themed to reduce eye strain. It conveys depth through borders and background color shifts, never shadows. data-ui-surface="admin" strips all box-shadows.

dos: Do use Uniform Green (#14532D) for headers, primary buttons, and the sidebar. It's the store apron — it goes where identity lives.
Do use Corner Callout Gold (#F6DB12) only when something needs attention — a sale badge, a promo strip, a rating star. If it appears without a semantic reason, remove it.
Do use rounded-none on product cards, badges, buttons, dialogs, and inputs. Square is the default. Round is the exception.
Do use hard-offset shadows (Xpx Ypx 0 rgba(0,0,0,1)) for interactive elevation. No blur, no spread — stamp, not glow.
Do use uppercase font-black tracking-tighter on section headings with a thick bottom border (border-b-4 or border-b-8 in #211414).
Do keep body text between 0.875rem and 1rem at a maximum of 65 characters per line.
Do use Feed Bag Cream (#FFF8D8) as the page background, never #FFFFFF or #000000.
Do pair Arvo display text with Inter body text. Never swap them.
donts: Don't use Shopify template patterns — hero sliders with stock photography, 'curated collections' language, generic trust badges, soft rounded card grids.
Don't look like Chewy.com — no big-box e-commerce polish, no algorithmic recommendation carousels, no impersonal scale.
Don't use generic SaaS cream — no white-plus-gray palettes, no ghost buttons, no soft rounded corners as the personality.
Don't build logo-first palettes — the site follows real-world recognition (green uniforms, green storefront), not the logo's color balance.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or list items. Use full borders, background tints, or leading numbers instead.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Every text element is a single solid color. Emphasis comes from weight and size.
Don't use glassmorphism or backdrop blurs decoratively.
Don't use the hero-metric template (big number + small label + supporting stats + gradient accent).
Don't build identical card grids with icon + heading + text repeated endlessly.
Don't use modals as the first solution. Exhaust inline expansion, sheets, and progressive disclosure first.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, top, left). Use transform and opacity only.
Don't add shadows to admin surfaces. The admin is border-only.
Don't use #000 or #fff anywhere. Ledger Charcoal and Feed Bag Cream are the darkest and lightest values.
